top_signals.title: BlackRock Turns Bullish on Short-Term Bonds, Downgrades Stocks
top_signals.summary: BlackRock Inc.’s research unit has turned more bullish US Treasuries, unwinding a “mainstay” underweight stance for most of the past six years, as yields climbed to the highest levels in more than two decades.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
